 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

technology_sectors = [
    'Biotech Therapeutics', 'AI Diagnostics', 'Solar Energy Storage',
    'Advanced Nanomaterials', 'Autonomous Robotics', 'Quantum Computing',
    '5G & 6G Infrastructure', 'Blockchain Applications', 'Clean Hydrogen Fuel',
    'Edge Computing Systems', 'Carbon Capture Tech', 'Neurotech Devices'
]

economic_impact = [
    28.5, 25.1, 22.3, 19.7, 16.4, 14.2,
    12.6, 11.0, 9.8, 8.9, 7.5, 15.3
]

colors = [
    '#f28e2b', '#4e79a7', '#e15759', '#76b7b2',
    '#59a14f', '#edc948', '#b07aa1', '#ff9da7',
    '#9c755f', '#bab0ac', '#8cd17d', '#f1ce63'
]

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 10))
ax = plt.subplot(111)

wedges, texts, autotexts = ax.pie(
    economic_impact,
    labels=None,
    colors=colors,
    startangle=90,
    counterclock=False,
    wedgeprops=dict(width=0.4, edgecolor='w'),
    autopct='%1.1f%%',
    pctdistance=0.8,
    textprops=dict(color='white', fontsize=10, weight='bold')
)

ax.legend(
    wedges,
    technology_sectors,
    title="Emerging Technology Sectors",
    loc="center left",
    bbox_to_anchor=(1, 0, 0.5, 1),
    fontsize=9
)

plt.setp(autotexts, size=8, weight="bold")
plt.title("Economic Impact Distribution of Emerging Technologies (2025)", fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.tight_layout()

import csv
p = Path("chart.py")
source = p.read_text()
start = source.index("economic_impact = [")
end = source.index("\n\ncolors =", start)
source = source[:start] + """with open('table.csv', newline='') as data_file:
    rows = list(__import__('csv').DictReader(data_file))
economic_impact = [float(row['Economic Impact (%)']) for row in rows]
""" .rstrip() + source[end:]
source = source.replace("'#f28e2b', '#4e79a7'", "'#4e79a7', '#f28e2b'")
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
print("Values:", economic_impact)
print("Labels:", [t.get_text() for t in autotexts])
print("First two wedge colors:", [w.get_facecolor() for w in wedges[:2]])
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()])
